title: When Shall the Voice of Singing
description: When Shall the Voice of Singing in Tonic Solfa to GREENLAND, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 2 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 300 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Universal Hallelujah”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens and Sixes Double (7.6.7.6.7.6.7.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to GREENLAND; any other Sevens and Sixes Double tune fits them as well.
underlay: When shall the voice of sing-ing Flow joy-ful-ly a-long? When hill and val-ley, ring-ing With one tri-um-phant song, Pro-claim the con-test end-ed, And Him, who once was slain, A-gain to earth de-scend-ed, In right-eous-ness to reign?

lines: When shall the voice of singing
And Him, who once was slain,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to GREENLAND by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
